user.title: Add a project
user.description: Monitor projects even when they are not installed locally. Enter a domain, a public GitHub repository, or both. Known mappings are suggested. Core integrations only have installation totals. Select a source explicitly to add a domain that is not yet present in Analytics.

error.invalid_repository: Enter owner/repository or a valid HTTPS GitHub repository URL.
error.patterns_required: Choose at least one release filename or pattern, such as *.zip. Multiple patterns count every matching file once.

error.invalid_data: The source returned an unexpected data format.

error.repository_moved: The GitHub repository moved. Enter its current owner/name.
error.core_repository: Core integration downloads cannot be separated from Home Assistant Core. Leave the repository empty.

init.title: Project settings
init.description: Previously tracked versions are retained even outside the top selection. Changing the repository or filename patterns starts new download series. Leave the token blank to keep the saved token. Manual refresh respects a five-minute cache window and GitHub limits.
